kanakku.description: Kanakku (கணக்கு) is a privacy-first expense tracker for Android. It automatically captures bank and UPI transactions from SMS and notifications, categorises them, and turns them into account balances, credit-card bill reminders, budgets and spending insights — no manual entry needed for day-to-day spending. Everything stays on your device: fully offline, no sign-up. Also includes manual entries, split bills, bank statement (CSV) import, backup & restore, and a PIN app lock.
